tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Current local time, UTC offset, DST status and the next clock change for a place or time zone. Uses the latest IANA tz data (more current than most runtimes). Accepts city names in German or English, time zone names ("Central Time", "MEZ") or IANA IDs.

tools.name: time_difference
tools.description: Time difference between two places now, and how it changes over the coming months because of clock changes.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a local wall-clock time in one place to another place. Reports nonexistent (DST gap) and ambiguous (DST overlap) times.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search about 6,400 cities, regions, time zone names and abbreviations; returns names, countries and IANA time zones.
